title: chore(docs): delete the dead content/docs.site.json config
body:
Fixes #12489

Deletes `content/docs.site.json` — measured dead config. The live docs-site config is `gitConfig` in `apps/docs/lib/layout.shared.tsx`.

The ruling attached a premise-first fence, so the census below is a **re-measurement on current `origin/main`**, not the card's numbers from `262145bef4`.

## 1. Reader census, re-run at `713f83f5d`

**The card's grep, verbatim scope** (`.ts/.tsx/.mjs/.js/.json`) — **11 hits, not the card's 7.** The count grew; the disposition did not. All 11 are comments or self-test fixtures in the same three gate scripts, and none is a read of the file.

**Per-key reader counts — every key's only repo-wide hit is its own definition line:**

| key | readers |
|:--|--:|
| `repoBaseUrl` | 0 |
| `showEditLink` | 0 |
| `showLastUpdate` | 0 |
| `transparentMode` | 0 |
| `imageZoom` | 0 |
| `defaultOpenLevel` | 0 |

**Widened beyond the card** (all file types, not just the five extensions; plus `siteConfig` / `docsSite` / `loadSiteConfig` / `site-config` / `site_config` / `SiteConfig`): **0 additional hits.** `apps/docs` performs no dynamic reads at all — its only `import()` is `mermaid`.

## 2. fumadocs convention check — the sharp risk

Checked against the **installed** packages, not the docs: `fumadocs-core@16.14.4`, `fumadocs-mdx@15.2.3`, `fumadocs-ui@16.14.4` (lockfile-pinned, verified in `node_modules`).

⚠️ **My first probe was insufficient and I am recording that, because it is the interesting half.** Grepping the installed tree for the literal strings `site.json` / `docs.site` / `siteConfig` returns 0 — but a negative control for `meta.json`, a convention fumadocs genuinely has, **also returned 0**. So the literal-filename probe cannot detect fumadocs conventions at all, and its zero was worthless.

fumadocs declares conventions as **globs**, not filenames. The real mechanism:

- `fumadocs-mdx/dist/transform-BFobDsdE.js:16` — `SupportedPatterns.meta = "**/*.{json,yaml}"`
- `fumadocs-mdx/dist/index-file-pX-fCn8l.js:176` — `glob(collection.patterns, { cwd: collection.dir, absolute: true })`

So fumadocs **does** collect JSON by convention — rooted at `collection.dir`. `apps/docs/source.config.ts` configures exactly two dirs, `content/docs` and `content/blog`. `content/docs.site.json` sits **beside** `content/docs/`, not inside it; relative to the glob root it is `../docs.site.json`, and `**` never matches `..`. Empirically, `find content/docs` returns 35 json/yaml files and the file is not among them, while `content/docs/meta.json` *is* — the convention is live and simply cannot reach one directory up.

Re-run with a working positive control: **0 convention reads, control found.** No live consumer. The ruling's premise holds.

Independent confirmation: `pnpm install` ran `apps/docs postinstall: fumadocs-mdx` to success **with the file already deleted**.

## 3. Disposition of the gate-script hits

`hintCovers` is **pure string logic** — no `fs`, no tracked-file lookup — so no assertion can break on the file's absence. And `extractWatchHints` yields **zero** `docs.site` hints from all three scripts, so the deletion creates no dead hint for `deadHintSweep`.

| site | kind | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `check-doc-formula-expressions.mjs:271` | comment | inert — gate green |
| `check-published-readme-links.mjs:92` | comment (records the stale-host incident) | inert — gate green |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs:2532`, `:2790` | docblock: a historical measurement record, and a statement about *strings* | left as-is, still true |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs:2535` | docblock asserting the file **is** a real file | tense corrected — that claim is now false |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs:8555`, `:8616`, `:8617` | executable self-test cases pinned on the file as a **live specimen** | **re-pointed** (below) |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs:8962` | executable self-test case | path kept, comment corrected (below) |

### The re-point, and why it is in this PR

`dispatch-gates.mjs:8614` carries a standing instruction from its author addressed to whoever removes this file:

> If `content/docs.site.json` is ever removed, re-point this case at whatever sibling pair the tree then has rather than deleting it.

Those cases assert a rule about a real FILE sitting beside a real DIRECTORY of the same name stem. They stay green either way, but they silently degrade from live specimen to hypothetical. Re-pointed at `packages/spec/authorable-surface` + `packages/spec/authorable-surface.base.json` — the same shape (dotted-suffix JSON sibling of a directory), both tracked, and a stable path. The positive leg was upgraded from a synthetic path to a real tracked file, `authorable-surface/ai.json`.

**One case was deliberately NOT re-pointed.** `:8962` asserts that the role-word hints — `['content/docs', 'scripts/role-word-baseline.json', 'skills/**']` — do not reach a sibling beside the content root. Its bite comes from the `content/docs` hint, and after this deletion `content/` holds only `blog/` and `docs/`, so the tree offers no replacement sibling there. Re-pointing it at a far-away path would keep it green while testing nothing — which the neighbouring comment explicitly forbids. The path is kept and labelled CONSTRUCTED in a comment.

Every executable line changed is inside `selfTest()` — only `t(...)` case arguments. No exported function body moved, so the ~60 consumer scripts that import this module are unaffected by construction.

## 4. Verification

Union re-run after the final commit, at `a8895c6e6`:

- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` — `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1017 cases pass.` (0 literal `✗`). The four edited cases confirmed executed, not skipped.
- `pnpm check:published-readme-links` — `✓ 176 outbound link(s) across 60 published markdown file(s)` — self-test green too
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions` — `✓ 58 cases passed` + live green
- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` — `OK (scanned 7560 text file(s))` + 75-assertion self-test
- Full derived family via `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (17 families, re-derived on a non-stale tree): all green

`node scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs` is **NOT MEASURED**, not red: it grades a saved `turbo run test` log that only CI produces, and exits 3 — a code it defines as distinct from a finding's 1.

## 5. Changeset

No changeset: this releases nothing from any package. `content/docs.site.json` is in no package, and `scripts/pm/` is CI-internal — `lint.yml:2280` names that exact case as "the textbook `skip-changeset` case — such a PR releases nothing". Label applied.

## Zone 2 assumptions

- **A2.1** (zero-reader census still holds) — **HELD**, re-measured.
- **A2.2** (`gitConfig` still live with four consumers) — **HELD**: view-source link `page.tsx:158`, navbar `layout.shared.tsx:26`, homepage `page.tsx:240`, JSON-LD `structured-data.tsx:25,28`.
- **A2.3** (deleting breaks no gate) — **HELD on the verdict, FALSIFIED on the count**: 11 hits, not 7. All inert; no gate breaks. The stated risk — a self-test fixture naming a path that no longer exists — was real in kind but not in effect, because `hintCovers` never touches the filesystem.
